title: Hosted macOS jobs never acquire a runner and cancel after 15 minutes
body:
﻿## Description
GitHub-hosted macOS jobs are repeatedly cancelled after approximately 15 minutes without ever acquiring a runner. This occurs before checkout and before any workflow step starts.

## Reproduction
Repository: https://github.com/Wentsy/Accessibilibili (public fork)
Workflow: `build-ios.yml`

Runs:
- https://github.com/Wentsy/Accessibilibili/actions/runs/41484214200 (`macos-26`)
- https://github.com/Wentsy/Accessibilibili/actions/runs/41501389117 (`macos-26`)
- https://github.com/Wentsy/Accessibilibili/actions/runs/41487831536 (`macos-26`, previous known-good branch)
- https://github.com/Wentsy/Accessibilibili/actions/runs/41463563008 (`macos-15`, temporary runner-label test)

For each affected job, the API reports:
- `conclusion: cancelled`
- `runner_name: ""`
- zero executed steps
- no job logs (logs endpoint returns no usable log archive)
- cancellation after about 15 minutes

The workflow is manually dispatchable, Actions is enabled, the repository is public, and there is no workflow `concurrency`, environment approval, or job condition. Changing `runs-on` from `macos-26` to `macos-15` produced the same result. The same project and workflow had previously acquired macOS runners successfully.

## Expected behavior
A GitHub-hosted macOS runner should be assigned and the first checkout step should begin.

## Actual behavior
The job remains queued with no runner assigned and is cancelled after approximately 15 minutes, before any step runs.

Could you confirm whether there is a hosted-runner provisioning or scheduling incident affecting this repository/account, or provide any additional diagnostic information?
